verdict.rationale: Asana runs a first-party App Directory (asana.com/apps) listing many integrations across collaboration, dev, sync, finance and AI tools (Slack, Jira, GitHub, Figma, Notion, Stripe, Xero and more). It also lists connector platforms like Zapier, n8n and Pipedream that bridge to further tools, and app components let third-party apps plug into the Asana UI. missing for 10: no evidence substantiating the "thousands" scale of the directory, no detail on the in-product install/authorization flow for a PM, no independent or hands-on corroboration of marketplace breadth.
